note: Fixed starting conditions for the benchmark suite (docs/EVALUATION.md). The anchor (S0) is the existing clean base, verified on disk. S1-S5 are seeded embarks: fixed world seed, fixed finder profile (M2_PROFILE from src/dfagent_harness/embark.py), fixed pick rule (first match, topmost then leftmost). Expected match count and start state are UNVERIFIED until each scenario is generated live twice from its registry entry and the same match count and start state are confirmed. S6 is held out of the published set and used only for verification runs. World region numbers are assigned at generation time and recorded back here after first generation; cross-machine determinism of seeded world gen is UNVERIFIED.
